notes.title: Updating “Backrooms:Last Room" is coming very soon - Welcome to the Hub!
notes.notes:
Hub Level: Are you lost? 

Are you lost in time and space? Don't worry! Now you have a central point – a safe (relatively) place where you can take a deep breath, prepare for new walks and team up with other researchers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871825/dec29ab6eda31cdd90a1058779048db6a705fc1f.jpg[/img]

[b]Hub Offers:[/b]
-Preparation Area: Organize your team, allocate resources, and plan your next expedition.

-[b]New Quests and Challenges[/b]: Explore the mysterious origins of the Hub and uncover its secrets by completing new quests from its mysterious inhabitants.

-[b]Performance Improvements [/b]: We have performed optimizations to improve FPS and stability of the game. Now the backstage rooms will become even smoother (and more intimidating).

-[b]Bug Fixes[/b]: We listened to your feedback and fixed a lot of bugs that prevented you from exploring these nightmarish spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871825/d7e3bc644159532eb5fb58d1912323ff8efdd936.png[/img]

Dive deeper into this madness!

The Hub level is not only a safe place, but also new opportunities to uncover the secrets of the backstage rooms. Are you ready to find out what lies behind the familiar walls?

[b]Join our community![/b]

We want to hear your impressions about The Hub level! Share your screenshots, videos, and stories on the Steam community and on our social networks! Your feedback will help us make "Backrooms: Last Room" even better.

KinTstudio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871825/a183600efb1b33f83b3a432fed852acaa6ed7348.png[/img]
